## Summary

- **Deleted dead code** — the legacy flat-layout `ImageGenerationSeam` adapter, mock, and fixtures were never imported by anything live. They created a naming clash (both `contracts/image-generation.contract.ts` and `src/lib/seams/image-generation-seam/contract.ts` exported an `ImageGenerationSeam` type), added 250+ lines of maintenance surface, and made the seam registry misleading by listing two entries with the same name.
- **Fixed inverted HTTP status codes** — `image-generation-pipeline.ts` had the status-code logic backwards: `IMAGE_VALIDATION_ERROR` was mapped to 503 (Service Unavailable) and `IMAGE_CONFIG_ERROR` was mapped to 502 (Bad Gateway). Both are now correct: `CONFIG_ERROR → 503`, `VALIDATION_ERROR → 400`, all other upstream failures → 502.
- **Added two regression tests** covering the corrected status-code mapping so this can't silently re-invert.
- **Cleaned up seam registry** (`docs/seams.md`) to a single canonical `ImageGenerationSeam` row pointing at the self-contained layout.

## What stays

`contracts/image-generation.contract.ts` is **kept** — it defines the HTTP API shapes (`ImageGenerationInputSchema`, `ImageGenerationResultSchema`, `GeneratedImage`) that are still actively used by the pipeline, `generate-pipeline.ts`, and four route components. Only the now-orphaned `ImageGenerationSeam` interface type was removed from it.

## Test plan

- [x] All 383 existing tests pass (`npm run test`)
- [x] `svelte-check` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings (`npm run check`)
- [x] Two new tests assert `IMAGE_CONFIG_ERROR → 503` and `IMAGE_VALIDATION_ERROR → 400`
- [x] Integration test for live xAI still skips cleanly when `FEATURE_INTEGRATION_TESTS` is unset
